subject: Demo timing update — team reprioritization; request to move
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@medicore.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@medicore.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-08-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick: Demo for Redwood Inference — proposed slots

Hi Alex / Sara,

Thanks again for the time on our discovery call last week. Based on what you shared about latency-sensitive search use cases, I think a short walkthrough of our dedicated inference controls and routing policies will be useful for your infra and product teams.

Can you confirm which of these slots work for a 45-minute demo with: me (Karthik), Lauren (product), and a short ops overview from our infra lead (optional remote):
- Tue Sep 7, 10:30–11:15 PT
- Wed Sep 8, 14:00–14:45 PT
- Thu Sep 9, 09:00–09:45 PT

I've attached a one-pager that summarizes the Dedicated offering and an agenda (redwood-one-pager.pdf). If none of those times fit, I'm happy to propose alternatives.

Next steps: please pick a slot or tell me an approximate timeframe and we'll lock it in.

Thanks,
Karthik
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.inference | (415) 555-0123

---
Attachment: redwood-one-pager.pdf (application/pdf, 210 KB)

From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@medicore.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Cc: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@medicore.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: Demo for Redwood Inference — proposed slots

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the follow-up and the one-pager — helpful context. I wanted to give you a quick update: we went into a company planning meeting this week and leadership has reallocated headcount and project focus for the next two quarters.

Specifically, the analytics team that would have driven the inference pilot is being pulled to support a regulation-driven sprint and two of our senior engineers are traveling for a customer rollout through October. Given that, we need to pause new vendor demos for any infrastructure-heavy initiatives while we stabilize.

Can we move this demo out of the calendar for now and revisit in early January? If it helps, I can add a tentative placeholder for the week of Jan 10, 2027. In the meantime, we would appreciate any self-serve materials or a recorded walkthrough we can share internally.

Apologies — I know this is a last-minute shift. We'll reach back when we have bandwidth.

Best,
Sara
Head of Data Platforms | MediCore Labs
sara.patel@medicore.com

---
Attachment: medicore-roadmap-summary.pdf (application/pdf, 120 KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@medicore.com>, Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@medicore.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-09-07T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: Demo for Redwood Inference — proposed slots

Sara — thanks for the update and totally understand.

Let's do this: we'll remove the current meeting invites and I'll put a tentative placeholder for the week of Jan 10, 2027 (no firm commitment). I'll also send over a short recorded run-through of the Dedicated flow plus a checklist your engineering team can use to scope an evaluation (self-serve assets).

If you do decide to keep a small sync in the interim (even 20 minutes), happy to do a concise technical Q&A to help the team plan. Otherwise, January sounds sensible given your travel and the regulation sprint.

I'll mark the HubSpot deal as 'paused — customer reprioritized' but keep the opportunity open and include the Jan placeholder date. Lauren — tagging you so we can coordinate a light nurture plan (quarterly check-ins + product updates).

Appreciate the heads-up.

—Karthik
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-09-08T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo timing update — team reprioritization; request to move

Thanks for the thread, Karthik.

Noted — will update the HubSpot stage to "Paused - Customer Reprioritized" and add a note about the tentative Jan placeholder. I recommend we:
- Offer a small nurture package (3 months of product update emails + 1 quarter replay of major roadmap items).
- Queue a support-lite recorded demo and the infra checklist Karthik mentioned.
- Hold off on credits/discounts for now; revisit if they push to a Proof-of-Concept next quarter.

Karthik: if you want, I can draft the nurture cadence and schedule the Jan placeholder as 'tentative' in the calendar (will not trigger reminders until we confirm).

Lauren: FYI — we should treat this as a low-touch opportunity until they re-open.

—Stephanie
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference

Note: marking as low priority in pipeline and attaching the customer's roadmap doc to the CRM.
